-Conditioning rule for tasks that require the exact target to be cooled or heated: after acquiring the target, go to the required appliance (fridge for cool, microwave for heat) and open it if closed. Perform the cool/heat action directly on the held target while at the open appliance; holding the target is sufficient in the observed environment. If the conditioning action is not offered for the held target, place the target inside once and perform the action, but never replace conditioning with repeated close/open or remove/reinsert cycles. Perform one conditioning action, then carry the target to the requested destination (opening it if closed) and place it there. If the conditioning appliance is also the destination, condition the target and then place it there.
